items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Jagdschein application
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Bescheiddatum is 19.11.2026 (Thursday), taken as the day of posting (Aufgabe zur Post) since no other date is given. Under §110 Abs. 2 LVwG SH, a decision sent by simple letter is deemed notified (Bekanntgabe) on the 4th day after posting: day1=20.11.(Fri), day2=21.11.(Sat), day3=22.11.(Sun), day4=23.11.2026 (Mon). 23.11.2026 is a normal weekday, so no shift is needed for the fiction of delivery. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §187 Abs. 1 BGB starting the day after Bekanntgabe, and ends under §188 Abs. 2 BGB on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of Bekanntgabe, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein, so the deadline is not shifted (§193 BGB does not apply).

items.title: Submit valid hunting liability insurance confirmation to obtain the Jagdschein
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: The letter does not set any deadline for submitting the renewed insurance confirmation; it only states that the Jagdschein will be issued once this proof is provided ('Sobald Sie...'), without a time limit. Therefore no exact due date can be computed; this remains an open-ended task until the applicant wants the licence issued.
